en: How do I create a merchant account?
I did not get the verification code

steps: Open /signup, enter email/phone and password, enter the OTP/verification link, then continue to onboarding.
edgeCases: Verification email/OTP not delivered: resend (rate limited per email and IP)
Signup velocity limiter per IP/subnet blocks bulk signups: shown as a wait message
Egyptian phone formats and Arabic-Indic digits must normalise
Email already registered: sign in or reset password
Mobile browser opens the OTP in another tab
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Assistant is not available before login: the public site has no help bot
